summary: The failures consistently add one extra zero for integer precision across static, dynamic, and positional printf formats. The shared integer writer is involved, but the supplied excerpts do not show how printf precision is parsed, assigned, or resolved, so the cause and repair location are not yet established.
hypotheses: The printf parser stores explicit integer precision one greater than the requested value.
The printf formatter adjusts precision incorrectly when applying parsed specs to the shared integer writer.
The shared integer writer interprets printf precision differently from the printf adapter’s convention.
